Every time I read something about Star Citizen, its promises and "unexpected delays", I think of this game.

Which is why it's so hilarious that Derek Smart is the one stirring up all this drama.

I backed Star Citizen a while back when it was still a simple game. I'm surprised to see how much its grown since the early Kickstarter days.

In the end though, I don't mind someone taking a big risk on a game like this. I back games like this specifically because I'm interested in people making attempts at larger games that aren't just tweaks on the existing popular formulas.

The problem with taking risks on big games like this is you are pretty much going to get criticism and hate up and until the point you deliver a finished product. There is really no way to alleviate the criticism about making the game too big, since big games take a lot of time and money to develop.

That doesn't mean I never want to see developers attempt to build a big game though.
